title: Recommendations for modular co-ordination : basic module and submodular increments (Equivalent to ISO 1006 and ISO 6514 : 1982)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers the definitions and symbol of basic module and sub-modular increments for modular co-ordination of building, for their constituent parts and for the building components used in their constituent parts and for the building components used in their construction, and also recommends their values.
clause_3_terminology: ordination : basic module and submodular increments

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
